text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally come for me to give
my
presentation in front of the other
trainers.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Time for our regular trainers' meeting.
I'm looking
forward to your presentation,

<username>!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I may not be as good as the veteran
trainers, but
I've learned how to put in
hard work through all
my strength
training, and I'm determined to do
my
best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: So... how did it go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Really?! That's fantastic! What a relief to
hear
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's not necessary! I didn't do
anything special.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I basically just gave you unsolicited
advice out of
nowhere... And all because
I saw myself in you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's just... I went through the same
thing
once...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I've always enjoyed being active, ever
since I was
little. That's what got me into
working out at first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then one day, my aunt told me I was
really
well-built for running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty plain and unremarkable for a
Mejiro,
but then I realized there was still
something that
set me apart too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My musculature was my strength, and I
was
determined to make it my weapon!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, I started working out even harder.
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I have to lift this much, or else! I... I
have to train
more!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
One day, I hit a wall and went into a
full-blown
panic. I threw myself
headlong into training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I even started forgoing sleep for the
sake of
training. Eventually, everyone
stopped me. And
then...

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Ardan that you've been
exercising
yourself sick.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! I'm just trying to get
stronger so—

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
You cannot cross a thousand miles in a
single
bound.

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
That goes for anyone, even McQueen
and Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
Ryan... Recognize the value in every step
you
take.

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
No matter how small the step you take
is, it is still
a step forward.

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
The barbells you've been lifting are
heavier than
the ones you used last year,
no?

text_block_list.name: Grandma Mejiro
text_block_list.text:
You have come to personify those very
barbells.
It's why we expect so much of
you. Do not forget
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We all tend to focus on making big

transformations and gaining huge
success.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But what's really important...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right! So long as you do a little every
day, there's
nothing you can't achieve!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why I really wanted you to
realize...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Just how amazing strength training is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure it was strength training
that taught
me the importance of
working hard every day,
not the other
way around, but oh well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure it was strength training
that taught
me the importance of
working hard every day,
not the other
way around, but oh well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What?! Me? A good presenter?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're kidding! That's, like, the last
thing I'm
good at! I hate standing in
front of people and
trying to explain
ideas.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Strength training lectures!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That actually sounds kinda fun... Want
to help me
practice doing presentations,
then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time later, I accompany her for her

presentation practice and further
increase my
knowledge on working out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I knew you'd understand me,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I've been thinking up a
workout
routine just for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I put together this routine for you
catered to your
habits and commonly
used muscles, which I
gleaned from
observing your training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You focused on training your upper
body last
time, so this routine targets
your lower half,
especially your thighs
and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She continues waxing poetic over the
regimen
she's put together for a long,
long time.
